description: Fetch the latest normalized Well-Architected report for a project.

baseUrl.description: Cloudeval API base URL. Defaults to the MCP server --base-url, active profile, CLOUDEVAL_BASE_URL, or the public API.

frontendUrl.description: Cloudeval frontend base URL for generated links. Defaults to --frontend-url, active profile, CLOUDEVAL_FRONTEND_URL, or public frontend.

profile.description: Cloudeval CLI config profile to read defaults from. Defaults to the server --profile or CLOUDEVAL_PROFILE.

projectId.description: Cloudeval project id. Defaults to active profile defaultProjectId, then Playground/first project where supported.

view.description: WAF view hint such as overview, rules, or raw.

name: reports_waf
title: Latest WAF Report
